issue: The Admin Pages create endpoint accepted isPublished=true after only checking canonical Page Model shape, bypassing the complete server publication contract and site-owned media checks used by Editor Publish.

implementation.change: Initial page creation validates the versioned Page Model before any write when isPublished=true. A shared publication media helper now enforces active media ownership by site and publishable MIME for both create-as-published and Editor Publish.
implementation.save_publish: Draft creation remains draft-only and can preserve incomplete content for repair. Existing Editor publish flow remains explicit.

new_cases: Invalid create-as-published returns 409 with no page/revision/audit writes.
Incomplete draft creation still succeeds as a draft.
Valid initial publish succeeds and its draft/published snapshots and revision match.
Cross-site media reference is rejected before any write.
